ClarksonsDigital learning2014–2015

Trainee Broker Programme

Clarksons, a company of 1,379 staff in 46 offices worldwide, needed one licence programme for trainee shipbrokers. I built 20 units of competency with assessments and interactive visual aids.

  • Instructional materials (writing, QA, ID)
  • Online modules, assessments and interactive visual aids (Captivate/HTML5/CSS3, Bootstrap and jQuery).
  • Offline training materials for learners and trainers: slides, quick reference guides and manuals
